name: Amtrak Accessibility Progress Report under the Accessible Canada Act, June 2026
known_limitations: The report gives aggregate accessibility inventories, remediation statements, and engagement activity, but it does not publish station- or equipment-level uptime, outages, maintenance, actual use, complaints, resolution time, boarding time, or rider outcomes.
